verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair axis for a SaaS observability platform, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of choosing a storage region (e.g., US vs. EU data centers). The only related item is a community comment that the cloud-hosted service is slow outside the US because of trans-oceanic latency. That comment hints there may be no in-region option, but it is not a residency control.
